question: Should OpenClaw adopt this permanent plugin SDK/manifest safety-event contract and the associated durable operator-visible event history as core product surface?
rationale: The code can enforce a chosen policy, but it cannot decide whether external plugins may publish these event classes, which metadata should persist, or what retention and operator-access guarantees OpenClaw should make.

options.title: Approve a bounded core contract
options.body: Sponsor the plugin and retention contract, document its privacy and compatibility rules, and require final-head end-to-end evidence before merge.

options.title: Narrow to core-only diagnostics
options.body: Remove or defer the public plugin manifest/service API and operator surfaces until a separate plugin SDK proposal is approved.

options.title: Keep it external for now
options.body: Pause this integrated feature and pursue an optional plugin or ClawHub implementation if core ownership is not desired.

recommendation.title: Approve a bounded core contract
recommendation.body: Sponsor the plugin and retention contract, document its privacy and compatibility rules, and require final-head end-to-end evidence before merge.
